name: muster-mob
body: Build the first named tool: muster mob. Verb muster, noun mob. Unslotted bots hear the open canvas and answer in waves; slotting quiets them to specific context. Bench has exactly three seats (scope check, not a widget cap). Roster behind it grows in threes. Fourth panel slot is the spend meter (session total plus per-seat spend), not a fourth bot. Power: unpowered / awake / knocked out. Tap opens the panel; press-and-hold toggles power. Tap to silence, double-tap knocks the bot onto the floor. Icon at cell size is unruled; do not invent one. Roster child already exists at rosters/tools/muster-mob/.
waitingOn: Owner Check, including tap-opens versus tap-to-silence, and the cell-size icon.
